items.label: Elegant Furniture Addition
items.value: This pair of accent chairs comes in handy when you require a piece of functional and stylish furniture. The faux leather covering adds a touch of luxury to this chair and the carved back and integrated arms complete its contemporary-traditional look. Ideal addition to the living room, bedroom, guest room, and also serves great in cafés and hotels

items.label: With Curved Armrest
items.value: For your advanced sitting experience, we also adopt the curved armrest design, flawlessly lining up with your arms

items.label: U-shaped Back Design
items.value: Our our accent leather barrel chair adopts the ergonomic U-shaped backrest design for more comfort, embracing you with softness and relieving your fatigue and tiredness

items.label: Protective Foot Pads
items.value: To prevent damage to both chair and floor and accommodate uneven surfaces, each leg of this faux leather accent chair is covered with adjustable foot pads

items.label: Easy Setup
items.value: Simple assembly is required. Only need to screw the four wood legs to the chair with bare hands and done

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Arm Rest, Cushion Availability, Ergonomic, Upholstered Leather

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bedroom, Dressing Room, Living Room, Office, Study Room

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Easy to Assemble: Screw four wood legs to the chair by hand.
